## 截图或日志

### IDEA 日志位置
- **macOS**: `~/Library/Logs/JetBrains/IntelliJIdea{版本}/idea.log`
- **Windows**: `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\JetBrains\IntelliJIdea{版本}\log\idea.log`
- **Linux**: `~/.cache/JetBrains/IntelliJIdea{版本}/log/idea.log`
